calls.title: aik-pqnh-pen
calls.summary: PepsiCo's team discussed their current use of a self-hosted version of GrowthBook, tailored for B2B solutions and supporting over 60 users. Compliance requirements prompted the self-hosted choice, necessitating internal management of updates and maintenance. They are currently on version 4.3, exploring the benefits of upgrading to version 5.0, which includes advanced features such as AI insights and better product analytics. A live demo was scheduled for next Tuesday to address feature capabilities and a roadmap review, while also seeking clarity on cost implications for a potential cloud migration. Participants emphasized coordination between procurement and GrowthBook for contract negotiations.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, self-hosted, cloud deployment, product analytics, feature flagging, AI integration
